goal: Push notification consent in mobile/lib/features/notifications/ and backend/services/.
summary: Implemented full push notification consent lifecycle across mobile and backend. Delivered explicit opt-in / opt-out consent flow, token registration endpoints, partner and teacher alert routing, and strict zero student PII enforcement in push notification payloads. Enforced negative abuse protections guaranteeing that user opt-out promptly stops notification delivery, revoked tokens cannot receive alerts, and provider invalidations automatically revoke device tokens.
invariants_enforced: EXPLICIT_CONSENT_OPT_IN_OUT: Users can explicitly grant or revoke push notification consent. When consent is revoked, push_enabled is set to False, the token is cleared, and push delivery promptly stops.
STRICT_ZERO_STUDENT_PII: Push notification title, body, and custom payloads are scanned for email, phone number, and student personal identifier patterns (StudentPIIDetectedError raised if detected).
TEACHER_ALERT_ROUTING: Classroom assignment events route alerts to teachers using sanitized curriculum descriptors and anonymous student references (zero raw names/emails/phones).
PARTNER_ALERT_ROUTING: Experience inquiry events route alerts to artisans/partners using experience metadata and opaque inquiry tokens without exposing visitor contact details.
REVOKED_TOKEN_DEFENSE: Revoked or unassigned tokens cannot receive alerts. Provider-level token invalidations (e.g. UNREGISTERED / NotRegistered) automatically trigger backend token revocation.

changes.description: Added teacher_alert and partner_alert to NotificationType enum.
Added PushConsentIn, PushConsentOut schemas; added alias support and platform normalization to PushTokenRegisterIn; updated valid_types in SendPushNotificationIn and BroadcastPushNotificationIn.

Implemented record_push_consent, revoke_push_token, assert_zero_student_pii, detect_student_pii, route_teacher_alert, route_partner_alert, register_push_sender/reset_push_senders, and auto-revocation on provider invalidation errors.
Integrated record_push_consent into register_push_token and revoke_push_token into unregister_push_token; added POST /api/v1/notifications/consent and GET /api/v1/notifications/consent endpoints.
Updated endpoint paths to /api/v1/notifications/register-push, unregister-push, consent, settings, and history with platform normalization and typed responses.
Added pushConsentGranted, pushEnabled, teacherAlerts, partnerAlerts to model and implemented togglePushConsent with backend synchronization and unregistration on opt-out.
Added Master Push Notification Consent Card with explicit opt-in/opt-out switch, privacy assurance badge guaranteeing zero student PII, and toggles for teacher and partner alerts.
Added consent check before registering device token; skips registration if user has opted out.
Added teacherAlert and partnerAlert to PushNotificationType enum with corresponding icons, colors, and priorities.
Added teacherAlert and partnerAlert to NotificationType enum with corresponding icons and colors.
Regenerated snapshot reflecting /api/v1/notifications/consent endpoints and PushConsentIn/PushConsentOut schemas.
Comprehensive test suite covering opt-in/out consent flow, token registration, teacher/partner alert routing, zero student PII enforcement, and negative abuse guardrails.

test_cases.name: test_push_consent_opt_in_and_opt_out_lifecycle

test_cases.name: test_token_registration_and_unregistration_endpoints
test_cases.assertion: Verifies POST register-push and DELETE unregister-push with platform normalization and fcm_token alias.

test_cases.name: test_teacher_alert_routing_positive

test_cases.name: test_teacher_alert_blocks_student_pii_leakage

test_cases.name: test_partner_alert_routing_positive

test_cases.name: test_partner_alert_blocks_visitor_contact_leakage

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_user_opt_out_promptly_stops_delivery
test_cases.assertion: Negative Abuse: User opt-out promptly stops notification delivery with zero alerts dispatched.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_revoked_token_cannot_receive_alerts
test_cases.assertion: Negative Abuse: Revoked or missing tokens cannot receive notifications.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_provider_invalidation_auto_revokes_token
test_cases.assertion: Negative Abuse: Provider token invalidation auto-revokes stored device tokens in DB.

test_cases.name: test_detect_student_pii_comprehensive
